    '{{log.scanned_files}}', '{{log.scanned_lines}}', '{{log.status_message}}',

    '{{log.level.info_selected}}', '{{log.level.warn_selected}}', '{{log.level.error_selected}}'
}

    raise SystemExit('Missing placeholders: ' + ', '.join(missing))

    'form action/method': 'action="/log.html" method="get"' in text,
    'date field name preserved': 'id="log-date" name="date"' in text,
    'level field name preserved': 'id="log-level" name="level"' in text,
    'keyword field name preserved': 'id="log-keyword" name="keyword"' in text,
    'all select values preserved': all(f'value="{value}"' in text for value in ['all', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error']),
    'date/level filter highlights only': text.count('class="field field-highlight"') == 2,
    'date/level metadata highlights only': text.count('class="meta-card meta-card-highlight"') == 2,
}
failed = [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]
if failed:
    raise SystemExit('Failed checks: ' + ', '.join(failed))

print('HTML parsed; placeholders and form/select invariants preserved; highlight class counts are correct.')
